H: CT number, the linear attenuation coefficient relative to water's
I: Mean excitation energy of the material
K: The scanner's three constants K_KN, K_coh and K_ph, which belong to its spectrum
K_KN: Scanner constant of Compton scattering (Klein–Nishina, per electron)
K_ph: Scanner constant of the photoelectric effect
L: Stopping number of the material in the Bethe formula
R: Water equivalent depth at which the plan places the distal R90
S: Stopping power of the material for the protons
a: Fraction of the range added as margin
beta: Speed of the protons as a fraction of the speed of light
gamma: Lorentz factor of the protons, 1/√(1 − β²)
i: Index of the elements in the material
k_coh: Ratio K_coh/K_KN, fitted from the phantom scan
k_ph: Ratio K_ph/K_KN, fitted from the phantom scan
mu: Linear attenuation coefficient of the material for the scanner's X-rays
mu_w: Linear attenuation coefficient of water for the same X-rays
rho_e: Electron density of the material, relative to water in the tables
w_i: Fraction by weight of element i in the material
z: Depth along the beam's path through the patient
z': Depth along the path, the variable of integration
z_target: Depth of the target's far edge along the path
